hold_text: Tier 2: DB writer on the live trader's close path. decision: 2026-11-12 operator decisions page w11 "Yes: store the venue's net closed P&L where trusted" (note: "Store the venue's always, it is the single source of truth and if we have a gap we need to understand why").
